source: WebSearch: NBA game prediction ML Brier SOTA 2026
title: Uncertainty-Aware Calibration for NBA Prediction (Targeting Brier < 0.22)

papers.title: Uncertainty-Aware Machine Learning for NBA Forecasting in Digital Betting Markets
papers.key_finding: RNN with Monte Carlo dropout achieves Brier ~0.20 with calibrated sequential probabilities
papers.technique: MC dropout for epistemic uncertainty quantification + team-level performance metrics + rolling-form indicators + spatial shot-chart embeddings
papers.cpu_insight: The calibration principle (uncertainty = ensemble spread) is applicable to CPU tree ensembles via prediction variance across bootstrap samples

papers.title: Stacked ensemble model for NBA game outcome prediction analysis
papers.key_finding: Stacked ensemble (NaiveBayes + AdaBoost + MLP + KNN + XGBoost + DecisionTree + LogisticRegression) outperforms individual models
papers.cpu_insight: Tree-only stacking already explored — key finding: heterogeneous base learners (not all boosted trees) reduce overfitting

papers.title: Integration of machine learning XGBoost and SHAP for NBA game outcome prediction
papers.key_finding: XGBoost + SHAP feature importance achieves ~0.68 accuracy and competitive Brier
papers.technique: SHAP-based feature pruning to select high-signal features
papers.cpu_insight: SHAP-based feature gate could replace/augment current GA feature selection — identify which of our 7213 candidates truly move Brier

current_fleet_status.constraint: CPU-only islands, no neural models, MAX_FEATURES=200

actionable_proposals.technique: Venn-Abers Fusion Extension to All Islands
actionable_proposals.rationale: S22 venn_abers_fusion is fleet best (0.22073). Currently only S22 uses this calibration. Extending to S13/S14/S15/S17/S18 via GA mutation could replicate the gain.
actionable_proposals.implementation: Add venn_abers_fusion as mutation option in each island's calibration parameter space. POST /api/config {mutation_add_calibration: 'venn_abers_fusion'} when islands wake.
actionable_proposals.status: QUEUED — pending S13/S18/S22 wake from gen=0 restart

actionable_proposals.rationale: MC dropout paper's rolling-form insight: recent games matter more. CPU equivalent: EWMA decay weights in tree model fit(). sample_weight[i] = exp(-lambda * (N - i)) where i is game index sorted by date.
actionable_proposals.implementation: Add sample_weight parameter to model.fit() calls in GA evaluation. Lambda = 0.01-0.05 (tune via GA). Already have game dates in feature pipeline.
actionable_proposals.effort: Medium — modify evaluation loop in island app.py

actionable_proposals.rationale: S14 top_performer uses isotonic_temporal calibration and achieves 0.22685 brier (best S14 individual, even though island best is 0.23493). This calibration reduces temporal drift in probability estimates.
actionable_proposals.implementation: Set isotonic_temporal as default mutation target in all islands. Current S14 island level still at 0.23493 — the GA needs to explore calibration more aggressively.

actionable_proposals.rationale: Stacked ensemble paper finds heterogeneous bases reduce overfitting vs homogeneous boosted trees. Current islands specialize in one model type. Mix: CatBoost + LogisticRegression + RandomForest with XGBoost meta-learner.
actionable_proposals.implementation: New island type: heterogeneous_stack. Would require new app.py variant. High effort.

cross_project_insight.finding: P2 (lightgbm, gen=20818) achieved new political fleet best 0.24956 — surpassing P7 gradient_boost at 0.24987 after ~20x more generations
cross_project_insight.implication: LightGBM gains from very long evolution runs. S14 (xgboost_brier) stagnates at 0.23493 after only 466 gens. Could benefit from either: (a) explicit long-run budget, or (b) switching to lightgbm.
cross_project_insight.recommendation: Consider POST /api/config to S14 with {model_override: 'lightgbm', run_budget_gens: 5000} once it responds. Cross-validate if lightgbm outperforms xgboost_brier on same feature set.

recommended_immediate_action: When S22 finishes waking: POST /api/config {inject_calibration: 'venn_abers_fusion'} to confirm the gen=39 checkpoint technique is preserved in the new run.
